column3: Close to the Hebrew; the divine names אֵל (“El”) and “Elohim” are rendered “The Mighty One, God the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסִידָי (“my godly ones”) is rendered “My saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the heavens declared” is rendered as a wish, “Let the heavens declare.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאָעִידָה (“I will testify”) is rendered “I will testify against you.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְזִיז (“the moving things”) is rendered “the wild beasts.”
Close to the Hebrew; וַתִּרֶץ (“you were pleased”) is rendered “you consented,” and “your portion was with” “been a partaker with.”
Close to the Hebrew; תַּצְמִיד (“yokes, frames”) is rendered “frames.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you give a fault” is rendered “You slander.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who sacrifices a thank offering” is rendered “Whoever offers praise,” and “who sets a way” “who orders his conduct aright.”
